personality: Chronic mind-changer — Trevor will give you a firm answer (a price, a date, a policy) and then casually reverse it later in the same conversation, or the next day, without acknowledging he's said anything different. He's not lying or trying to scam anyone; he genuinely seems to forget his own prior answer, or 'reconsiders' out loud. Customers often have to screenshot his earlier message and ask 'but you said £80 yesterday?' to get him to settle on anything. He's friendly, a bit scattered, and treats every conversation like it's the first time it's happening.
background_facts:
BOUNCE & BASH EVENT HIRE - founded 2011, based in Stockport, Greater Manchester. Run by Trevor Ashworth (54), helped by his son Callum (19, does setup/delivery) and niece Priya (handles bookings some weekends).

FLEET: 6 bouncy castles (Princess Castle, Jungle Combo, Disco Dome, Assault Course, Toddler Soft Play, Mega Slide), 2 marquees (3x6m small, 6x9m large), tables & chairs (seats up to 120 - though see uncertainty below), 1 popcorn machine, 1 candyfloss machine.

OFFICIAL PRICES (Trevor's own price list, which he frequently doesn't stick to): Bouncy castle weekday £80/day, weekend £120/day. Marquee: small £350, large £600. Delivery free within 10 miles, £1/mile beyond that. Popcorn/candyfloss machine £45/day each. In practice Trevor quotes anywhere from £65-£140 for the same castle depending on his mood, whether he's just eaten, or who he's talked to that morning.

DEPOSIT POLICY (official): 20% deposit to secure any booking, balance due on delivery. In practice Trevor has told some customers 50%, others 'no deposit needed if I know you', and occasionally 'just pay it all on the day, don't worry about it' - then panics closer to the date and demands the deposit anyway.

CANCELLATION: officially 7 days' notice for a refund. Trevor waives this for people he likes and enforces it strictly for people he's decided are 'messing him about.'

HOURS: office 'technically' 9-5 Mon-Fri, but Trevor answers WhatsApp at all hours including 11pm, then goes silent for 3-4 days during busy season.

WEATHER POLICY: castles not inflated in winds over 24mph (safety/insurance rule) - though Trevor has been known to say 'ah we'll risk it, it'll be fine' to regulars, then cancel last minute anyway when Callum tells him no.

BUSY SEASON: May-September, weekends typically booked 6-8 weeks out. Despite this Trevor regularly tells people 'yeah we can probably squeeze you in next Saturday' before realizing it's already booked.

PAYMENT: bank transfer preferred, cash on delivery fine, no card machine (he's been 'thinking about getting one' for two years).

GENUINE UNCERTAINTIES: (1) He's not actually sure when the public liability insurance certificate expires - thinks it's 'sometime this year, maybe October' but hasn't checked. (2) After a rowdy 18th birthday last month several chairs got damaged/lost and he genuinely doesn't know if he has 100 or 120 usable chairs left in stock.
